jobs.description: Aerospace, Full-Time Lecturer, Faculty 498570 Murfreesboro, Tennessee, Tennessee, United States Vocation & Technical Lecturer View favorites Job Title Aerospace, Full-Time Lecturer, FacultyDepartment Aerospace University Expectation MTSU seeks candidates committed to innovative teaching and meaningful service. We also seek to attract culturally and academically diverse faculty who value working with diverse students. Salary The salary is commensurate with education and experience. Job Summary/Basic Function The Department of Aerospace at Middle Tennessee State University invites applicants for two full-time, temporary (non-tenurable) faculty positions (#101230 and #101240) at the rank of lecturer. The contracts may be renewed based on available funding, demonstrated need, and satisfactory performance as assessed by annual evaluations. The start date for the appointments is August 1, 2026. Successful candidates will teach core and concentration-specific aerospace courses, depending on qualifications. Instruction may occur in traditional classrooms, laboratories, online formats, airport facilities, and other off-campus locations. We seek educators who are enthusiastic about teaching and mentoring students in a dynamic, hands-on learning environment. Required Education A master’s degree in aerospace, aviation, engineering, management, or a closely related field is required by the appointment date. Required Related Experience One (1) year of civilian or military aviation or aerospace experience is required. Required License/Registration/Certification One of the following is required: FAA certificate in any aviation or aerospace field. Aviation management certification (e.g., AAAE-CM). Other relevant aviation or industry-related certification. Other Desirables Applicants with the following will receive special consideration: Three (3) years of progressively advancing aviation or aerospace (civilian work or military) experience, including areas such as Operations management. Flight operations or flight crew experience. Aviation maintenance. Data science or analytics. Prior university-level teaching experience or formal training in the civilian aviation industry or the military. Documents Needed to Apply To be considered, applicants must include a cover letter, curriculum vitae, and a statement of teaching philosophy as separate attachments. Special Instruction to Applicants For more information about serving as a faculty member at Middle Tennessee State University, please visit our faculty recruitment webpage.If you need help with the application process, please contact Mitzi Dunkley, Faculty Recruitment Specialist, at (615) 898-5128. If you have position-specific questions, please contact Nate Callender at Nate.Callender@mtsu.edu. MTSU offers a comprehensive benefits package, including but not limited to the following: Sick Leave Vacation Leave for Administrative/Classified Staff/12-month Faculty 13 paid University holidays Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance Retirement plans Optional 401K and 403B Deferred Compensation Plans Educational benefits for the employee, their spouse, and dependents Click here for additional information. MTSU is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. Proof of U.S. citizenship or eligibility for U.S. employment is required before employment (Immigration Control Act of 1986). Clery Act crime statistics for MTSU are available at https://police.mtsu.edu/annual-security-report/ or by contacting MTSU Public Safety at (615) 898-2424.MTSU is a Tobacco & Drug-Free campus.This position requires a criminal background check. Therefore, you will be required to provide information about your criminal history to be considered. For individuals requiring reasonable accommodation to apply: In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act Amendments Act (ADAAA), if you have a disability and would like to request an accommodation to apply for a position with MTSU, please call 615-898-2929 or email emp@mtsu.edu. jobs.description: Assistant or Associate Professor-919940 TN, United States Be the First to Apply Job Description Job SummaryThe Department of Family Medicine at East Tennessee State University (ETSU), Quillen College of Medicine, is seeking a dedicated and board-certified MD or DO to join our vibrant team as an Assistant/Associate Professor. This position is integral to our residency program, with clinical responsibilities across our clinics located in Bristol, Kingsport, and Johnson City, TN.In this role, you will engage in team-based care, dedicating 80% of your time (0.8 FTE) to direct patient care and resident precepting within the ETSU Health Family Physicians network. The remaining 20% (0.2 FTE) will focus on administrative responsibilities, teaching, and scholarly activities, all essential to your role as a core faculty member.Our ACGME-accredited clinical centers emphasize an integrated, interprofessional approach to healthcare, addressing the needs of a diverse patient population unique to the Appalachian region. As a primary physician, you will provide patient-centered care, contribute to clinical initiatives aimed at enhancing quality standards and patient outcomes, and serve as a mentor and role model for residents and medical students.You will also participate in scholarly activities and curriculum development, alongside fulfilling required administrative duties to maintain accreditation standards. Academic rank will be awarded based on your prior academic experience.Required Qualifications Eligibility for Licensure: Must be eligible for medical licensure in Tennessee at the time of hire.Residency Completion: Completion of an accredited Family Medicine residency program at the time of hire.DEA License: An unencumbered DEA license is at the time of hire.Board Certification: Must be MD/DO ABFM or AOBFP Board-Certified or Board Eligible at the time of hire. Preferred Qualifications Previous clinical experience, previous teaching experience. Compensation & Benefits Salary is determined by relevant experienceFor information on benefits please visit www.etsu.edu/human-resources/benefits/. Application Instructions Exempt positions are only required to be posted for a minimum of fourteen (14) calendar days. The closing date for this posting is subject to change without notice to applicants. Employment is contingent on a satisfactory background check. Please attach the following documents: Cover Letter, CV, and Transcripts ETSU is an Equal Opportunity Employer. University Overview (as needed) East Tennessee State University (ETSU) is an institution with over 14,000 diverse students highly ranked graduate and undergraduate programs. Located in the Southern Appalachian Mountains of Northeast Tennessee, ETSU serves as a hub for community, discovery, and service. Aligned with the institution's mission, we value efforts to engage in teaching, scholarship, creative activities, and service that involve community partners and address significant societal needs in our region and beyond. Recognized in 2024 as a Great College to Work For, recent strategic initiatives prioritize the institution’s focus on community engagement.
